name: SVG.js
category: A4. Vector, typography, diagrams and stills
role: Chainable SVG construction in browser or Node; animation runner is not seekable
summary: Lightweight JavaScript library for creating and manipulating SVG in a browser or Node (with svgdom). Builds shapes, gradients, groups, paths and transforms with a chainable API and ships its own animation runner. In VCR use it for programmatic SVG construction and let GSAP own the timeline. Output is SVG DOM or a serialised string.
use_when: Building SVG shapes programmatically with a small chainable API; lighter than D3 for plain drawing
Generating SVG strings in Node with svgdom for later rasterisation by resvg
Manipulating existing SVG ids and attributes from script
avoid_when: Seekable animation: its runner uses a real-time clock, use GSAP
Static templates with no DOM needs: string-built SVG
notes: 2026-10-26: Node usage needs svgdom; its compatibility with 3.2.8 was not checked.

assessment.rationale: npm 3.2.8 published 2026-08-04 after 3.2.7 on 2026-07-19; MIT; repository pushed 2026-08-04. Overlaps GSAP and D3 on animation and data work but remains the simplest SVG builder.
